_comment: Drop under the 'mcpServers' key in Claude Desktop config (~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json — open via Settings > Developer > Edit Config) or Cursor mcp.json, then FULLY QUIT (Cmd+Q) and reopen the host. Uses `uv` so the server runs in the lab's venv — bare `python` uses system Python and won't find fastmcp/qdrant-client (ImportError). Exposes rag_query, rag_status, rag_decompose. Set the absolute --directory path + env for your machine.
_comment_web: Web fallback backend precedence: SEARXNG_URL → TAVILY_API_KEY → DuckDuckGo. SEARXNG_URL points at the free local metasearch (start: docker compose -f searxng/docker-compose.yml up -d); it ranks free sources above paywalled aggregators, so comparison queries ground real figures (§3.3). Drop SEARXNG_URL to fall back to Tavily (add TAVILY_API_KEY) or keyless DuckDuckGo.
